_comment: The system tags every budget is seeded with, in order. One list, two languages: backend/tests/unit/test_system_tags_agree.py holds repositories/tag_repo.py SYSTEM_TAGS to it, and frontend/src/components/settings/TagsPanel/SystemTagsHelp.test.tsx holds SYSTEM_TAG_HELP to it. The help once kept a hand-copied list with a comment pointing at the backend, and a seventh tag shipped with no explanation while that test stayed green.
